spec.hosting: Public GitHub repository; no domain, no server, no environment variables.

ci.trigger: Every push and every pull request.
ci.matrix: Python 3.11 and 3.14, each on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest (4 jobs).
ci.steps: checkout, setup-python, pip install -c constraints.txt -e .[dev], ruff check, pytest.

spec.release: Tag v0.1.0 on GitHub; no PyPI publication in version 1.
spec.clean_build: Before publishing: create a fresh environment, install the package with constraints.txt and run analyze on ledger_planted.csv.
spec.rollback: Delete the tag and revert the commit.
